tldr: 台股週五狂飆 3,186 點、創史上最大單日漲點收 43,119 點，台積電亮燈漲停 2,425 元。
AI 伺服器需求持續推升台積電及半導體鏈的目標價上修。
七家銀行獲准八月起採用內部評等法（IRB），釋放資本動能。
金管會金融大回饋指引列 22 項目、深化社會信任。
富豪財管規模逼近 2.7 兆元，需求轉向另類資產與家族辦公室服務。

items.title_zh: 台股狂飆 3,186 點、史上最大漲點收復 43,000
items.title_en: TAIEX surges a record 3,186 points to reclaim 43,000
items.summary_zh: 台股週五在權值與高價股集體亮燈漲停帶動下，加權指數大漲 3,186.45 點、寫下史上最大單日漲點，收 43,119.75 點，成交值 8,337 億元。台積電、聯發科、日月光等領軍反攻，扭轉七月中下旬的弱勢格局，重新站回 4 萬 3 關卡，為八月行情奠定偏多氛圍。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rocketed 3,186.45 points on Friday, its largest single-day gain in history, to close at 43,119.75 on turnover of NT$833.7 billion. Heavyweight and high-priced names went limit-up en masse, led by TSMC, MediaTek and ASE, marking a sharp late-July rebound after weeks of pressure. The move restored the 43,000 level and reset short-term sentiment heading into August.

items.title_zh: 月線視角：即便週五噴出，七月仍累跌逾 3,006 點
items.title_en: Monthly context: July still ended down 3,006 points despite Friday's spike
items.summary_zh: 儘管創下史上最大單日漲點，加權指數七月整體仍累計下跌約 3,006 點、單週小跌約 535 點，凸顯本月震盪劇烈。週五急拉屬月底多頭的絕地反攻，而非穩定上行，後續能否延續買盤、確認反轉，仍待觀察，投資人宜留意追高風險。
items.summary_en: Even after the record one-day rally, the TAIEX finished July with a cumulative loss of about 3,006 points and was down roughly 535 points on the week, underscoring how volatile the month was. The Friday surge was an "absolute counter-attack" by bulls at month-end rather than a smooth uptrend, leaving the index reliant on follow-through buying to confirm the reversal.

items.title_zh: AI 浪潮助攻，台積電目標價頻遭上修
items.title_en: AI wave drives fresh TSMC target-price upgrades
items.summary_zh: 多家機構近期再度調升台積電目標價，看好 AI 伺服器與高效能運算需求維持高強度。樂觀情緒外溢至整體半導體供應鏈，成熟製程與封測族群獲資金強力回補，反映下半年終端需求與 AI 晶片封裝產能預期轉強。目標價上修再度確立台積電作為大盤獲利與指數重心的地位，帶動族群比價效應。
items.summary_en: Multiple institutions have again lifted price targets for TSMC, citing sustained high-intensity demand for AI servers and high-performance computing. The optimism has rippled through the wider semiconductor supply chain, with mature-process and packaging/testing names drawing strong fund inflows as second-half end-demand and AI-chip packaging capacity expectations firm up. The upgrades reinforce TSMC's role as the market's key earnings and index anchor.

items.title_zh: 台積電擴產：大手筆資本支出對應滿手 AI 訂單
items.title_en: TSMC's expansion push: heavy capex to meet full AI order book
items.summary_zh: 台積電持續擴充產能以消化滿手 AI 相關訂單，市場傳出約 580 億美元規模的擴產投資，主要投入支撐 AI 加速器的先進製程，展現對多年需求的信心。法人維持正向看法，認為高強度資本支出既鞏固先進製程議價力，也帶動台灣科技業整體資本支出循環，是產業鏈中長線成長的重要引擎。
items.summary_en: TSMC continues to ramp capacity to satisfy a full slate of AI-related orders, with reported plans for large-scale investment of around US$58 billion in expansion. The bulk of spending targets advanced nodes that underpin AI accelerators, signalling confidence in multi-year demand. Analysts remain constructive, arguing the capex intensity supports both leading-edge pricing power and the broader Taiwan tech capex cycle.

items.title_zh: 七銀行獲准八月起採內部評等法，資本擴增大利多
items.title_en: Seven banks cleared to adopt internal ratings-based capital method from August
items.summary_zh: 主管機關將准許包含國泰世華、台北富邦等七家銀行，自八月起就信用風險採用內部評等法（IRB），屬資本適足率一大利多。IRB 依個別借款人信用狀況與違約機率計算風險權數，取代一致性權數，通常可釋放資本、優化帳面比率，讓獲准銀行在放款與股東回報上擁有更大成長空間，強化競爭優勢。
items.summary_en: Regulators are set to let seven banks—including Cathay United and Taipei Fubon—use the internal ratings-based (IRB) approach for credit risk starting in August, a significant capital-adequacy positive. IRB lets banks calculate risk weights from each borrower's credit profile and default probability rather than applying uniform weights, typically freeing up capital and improving reported ratios, giving approved lenders more room to grow lending and returns.

items.title_zh: 金管會推金融大回饋指引、列 22 項目
items.summary_zh: 金管會 7 月 29 日發布深化金融業社會信任指引，列出 22 項行動方案，將金融機構的社會貢獻由附屬活動提升為核心策略。框架鼓勵長期規劃、公私協力與共享參與平台，引導銀行、保險與券商把社會影響力納入主流業務，而非一次性公益。此舉可望強化業者與社會之間的正向信任循環，並影響長期經營布局。
items.summary_en: On July 29 the Financial Supervisory Commission released guidelines to deepen social trust in the financial industry, listing 22 action items that reposition institutions' social contribution from a supplementary activity to a core strategy. The framework encourages long-term planning, public-private collaboration and shared-participation platforms, nudging banks, insurers and brokers to embed societal impact into mainstream business rather than treat it as one-off philanthropy.

items.title_zh: 富豪財管規模逼近 2.7 兆元，高階客戶年增逾七成
items.title_en: HNW wealth-management assets approach NT$2.7 trillion
items.summary_zh: 台灣高資產財富管理業務規模逼近 2.7 兆元，高階客戶數年增逾 70%。此一成長反映富裕客層對整合式理財顧問服務、而非單一金融商品的強勁需求，也顯示近期開放銀行與券商承作高資產業務的鬆綁措施逐步發酵。各家機構為爭取頂端財富客層競爭轉趨激烈，帶動另類投資與客製化服務加速發展。
items.summary_en: Assets under Taiwan's high-net-worth wealth-management programme are nearing NT$2.7 trillion, with high-tier client numbers up more than 70% year-on-year. The surge reflects strong demand from wealthy individuals for integrated advisory rather than more standalone products, and signals that recent regulatory easing to let banks and brokers serve HNW clients is gaining traction, intensifying competition among institutions for the top wealth tier.

items.title_zh: 銀行業籲擴大另類資產、深化家族辦公室服務
items.title_en: Banks push alternatives and family offices for the ultra-wealthy
items.summary_zh: 亞洲資產論壇上，銀行業高層指出超高資產客戶真正需要的是整合式財富管理、而非更多商品，並呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財管服務。業者坦言，台灣高資產客戶目前仍難透過國內金融機構取得私募股權、私募債權與避險基金等機會，點名家族辦公室與私募市場為在地財管平台的下一個成長前沿，商機可期。
items.summary_en: At an Asian asset forum, banking executives argued the ultra-wealthy need integrated wealth management, not more products, and urged wider allocation to alternatives and deeper cross-border services. They flagged that Taiwan's HNW clients still struggle to access private equity, private credit and hedge funds through domestic institutions, pointing to family offices and private markets as the next growth frontier for onshore wealth platforms.
